name: Unleashed
tagline: A central portfolio, with the tools to make music with artists anywhere in the world. Free to play.
support_note: A contribution link is coming soon.
intro: I built Unleashed for myself: one place for everything I make, and the tools to collaborate easily with artists around the world. BONHOMME is a person like any other. I believe anyone with the same knowledge, experience and talent would make the same decisions. So the tools are here for every artist who joins.
